import time
area_by_type=[s[0]*s[1] for s,q in rect_specs]
qty0=tuple(q for s,q in rect_specs)
solutions=[]; callcount=0

def exact_cover(covered, qtys, placed):
 global callcount
 callcount+=1
 if not any(qtys):
  if covered==allbits: solutions.append(placed.copy())
  return
 options_best=None
 uncovered=allbits ^ covered
 bits=uncovered
 while bits:
  bit=bits&-bits; ci=bit.bit_length()-1; bits-=bit
  opts=[p for p in cell_opts[ci] if qtys[p[0]] and not (p[1]&covered)]
  if not opts:return
  if options_best is None or len(opts)<len(options_best):
   options_best=opts
   if len(opts)==1:break
 for ti,bm,coord in options_best:
  q=list(qtys);q[ti]-=1
  exact_cover(covered|bm,tuple(q),placed+[coord])
  if len(solutions)>=50:return
exact_cover(0,qty0,[])
